case_number: 2025 INSC 358; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) NO.7261 OF 2024)
summary: Custody enforcement vs modification petitions; welfare of minor paramount; child's consistent refusal to meet father; execution petition not stayed pending modification; Family Court orders for visitation/video calls violated; High Court error in remanding execution; custody determination under Guardians and Wards Act, 1890; no strict legal precedent binds child welfare decisions; child's psychological state considered.
legal_provisions_cited: Nil Ratan Kundu v Abhijit Kundu, 2008 (9) SCC 413
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; execution proceedings to proceed; Family Court directed to implement existing custody order without waiting for modification petition.
